description: "Chart data for [ticker]" / "sparkline data for [stock]" / "price history for [ticker] this week" — OHLCV price bars for a ticker from the StockTwits chart feed: 5-minute bars for one trading day (1D), ~30-minute bars for a week (1W), daily bars for 1M/3M/6M/YTD, weekly for 1Y, monthly for 5Y/ALL. Returns open, high, low, close and volume per bar. Crypto uses the StockTwits suffix (BTC.X). Use for thumbnail charts and quick recent-price context beside StockTwits sentiment; prefer dedicated finance packs (yahoo-finance, alphavantage) for serious price analysis.

symbol.description: Ticker without the $ (AAPL, TSLA; BTC.X for Bitcoin).
